title: Post-viral illness literature index: Long COVID, PACVS, ME/CFS, Lyme, Gulf War Illness, MCAS and POTS
description:
Per-condition indexes of peer-reviewed studies on post-viral illnesses, retrieved from PubMed (PMID, title, publication date, journal, authors, link), plus the OSMF cross-condition reference file describing each illness (triggers, onset, core features, epidemiology, mechanisms, diagnosis, treatments studied, references).

PubMed abstracts present in the live tracker files are removed from this deposit because they are copyrighted by their publishers; follow the PMID to read them. post-viral-illness.schema.json describes post-viral-illness.json only; the per-condition files are documented below.

Live, daily-updated version: https://research.opensourcemed.info/post-viral-illness.html. Built from commit 07f96ce4766e of the OSMF Research Tracker.

Research information, not medical advice.
